0xbd87f4da73ff92a7bea31e2de20e14f9829f42.name: Keepers of Wisdom_02
0xbd87f4da73ff92a7bea31e2de20e14f9829f42.description: Legend spoke of a ritual where the most devout of 'The Keepers' would meditate before The Nexus Hive, their consciousness merging with the collective knowledge of the bees. Upon awakening, they would inscribe new symbols, ensuring the continuum of wisdom from one generation to the next.

0x4ac251da6af98d7018cb8a722b3b5ab602f75f.name: Dreamvibe  1
0x4ac251da6af98d7018cb8a722b3b5ab602f75f.description:
This is a track we created a few years ago during my close friend Gabe's birthday at Defiant Studios. Gabe invited a few local Richmond artists, producers, and writers to Defiant to celebrate. During those sessions I met Elle Symone. Cas and I were coming up with idea when Elle walked in the room and she immediately started freestyling to it. We thought she would be perfect for the song so we finished arranging the song and got her in the booth. She did this whole song in one take 0.0 !!! That night we made a few more songs that will be included in our EP dropping at the top of 2023. Mint this song to receive an airdrop from our upcoming EP, WILD LIFE, in early 2023. Open until 12AM EST 12/06/22. 

50% of proceeds supporting https://juicebox.money/@campfir3
🏕️🔥

Cover Art by Midjourney

0x10d32bf55f5cbe66b068f2109ecf7475f0631d.name: Planet X 1/25
0x10d32bf55f5cbe66b068f2109ecf7475f0631d.description:
Savage Planet is a sonic journey into the wild. An introduction to a world with no rules - a world where instincts subjugate convention and imagination is your only compass. 

This concept was spurred from a moment in both producers' lives where they simultaneously felt inspired to let go of the traditional pop structure they were so used to adhering to. Instead, they chose to create music that mirrored a free flow of consciousness that came about as a direct result of the inspiration they felt when creating this music. As a result, most of the project was created in one night.

Creative Direction and Production by Xmane and Pete Rango
3D Animation: Nawt Creative

0x1baf95bab135ea5817606dc8ec27e64dabe171.name: Tragg Park 1/25
0x1baf95bab135ea5817606dc8ec27e64dabe171.description:
The artwork of the film “La Planete Sauvage”, featured wild, imaginative imagery that felt refreshing and freeing to watch - it seemed almost as if the artists and animators working on this piece had free reign to express their imagining of this world however they saw fit - Our music was approached with the same freedom and abandon

Creative Direction and Production by Xmane and Pete Rango
3D animation: Nawt Creative

0x2db9c2070d4cc57345d34e526e998d3fb6c715.name: Oms at Play 1/25
0x2db9c2070d4cc57345d34e526e998d3fb6c715.description:
Savage Planet is a sonic journey into the wild. An introduction to a world with no rules - a world where instincts subjugate convention and imagination is your only compass. 

Inspired by “Le Planete Sauvage”, a movie that featured aliens and humans alike in a wild planet inhabited by a variety of beasts and creatures beyond anything seen by the human eye before the film’s release - The medium displayed several moments that garnered our attention; from moments of light playfulness, moments of violence and aggression as well as moments so bizarre one could only watch and see how the situation evolved. 

Creative Direction and Production by Xmane and Pete Rango
3D Animation: Nawt Creative
